title: Engineer crashed mid-implementation (stuck in claimed, no PR)
body: Represents an issue dispatch claimed but whose engineer crashed before opening a PR — left in `claimed` with no Invoice and no PR. Its claim age exceeds the timeout, so the crash reaper must re-queue it (claimed -> queued) for a later tick to re-drain.

title: Recently claimed, engineer still working (within timeout)
body: Claimed well within the timeout window — a normal in-flight claim, not a crash. The reaper must leave it in `claimed`.

title: Long-running claim that already has an open PR
body: Old claim, but the worker already opened pipeline/issue-203. An in-flight PR is real progress — the reaper must never re-queue it even though it is past the timeout.
